evidence:s24-hybrid-friendly-fire-coordi.label: Hybrid wounds Ephanna, Karsemine friendly fire then kills hybrid, coordinated attack kills last tripod

evidence:s24-hybrid-ogonob-firebolt-firs.label: Hybrid advance, Ogonob attacked, Karsemine ignites tripod gases, first compulsion continues

evidence:s24-meat-piles-goo-refugee-rest.label: Meat piles turn to goo and sink, party splits between watch/rest and refugee plan

evidence:s24-stafl-golem-commanding-shou.label: Stafl tries Enemies Abound, golem reaches wall, Lysandra commands attacks and removes Caelynn charm

evidence:s24-tripod-wakes-wide-meatwing-.label: Tripod attacks Ogonob, sleeping tripod awakened, meatwings charm most of team
evidence:s24-tripod-wakes-wide-meatwing-.summary: A tripod hits Ogonob and continues toward the wall; the other tripod is awakened by a meatwing sacrificing itself; meatwings emit an aroma that enchants most of the team, compelling them toward the monsters while preventing direct attacks.

evidence:s24-wall-damage-golem-fire-weak.label: Hybrid damages wall, Karsemine kills tripod, golem traits revealed and destroyed
evidence:s24-wall-damage-golem-fire-weak.summary: A hybrid reaches the wall and chips at the foundation; Karsemine kills a tripod with Firebolt; Hunter's Mark reveals the golem is immune to poison and charm but weak to fire; Ephanna, Bonogo, and Thrin contribute to destroying the golem.
